description_en: Batch deletes key-value pairs from a specified KV namespace based on a specified list of key names. The maximum request body size is 100 MB
description_zh: 根据指定的键名列表批量删除指定KV存储空间下的键值对，最大允许上传100M的请求体
name: BatchDeleteKvWithHighCapacity

parameters.description_en: The namespace name specified when you called [CreateKvNamespace](~~2850317~~).
parameters.help_en: The namespace name specified when you called https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850317.html
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description_en:
The download URL that contains the key-value pairs to be batch deleted, such as an OSS download URL with read permissions.

- When you call this operation by using the SDK, the SDK automatically uploads the content to OSS and passes the corresponding URL.

- To call this operation directly, upload the JSON payload (in the same format as the BatchDeleteKv body: {"Namespace":"...","Keys":[...]}) to an OSS bucket and generate a signed HTTPS GET URL.
parameters.description_zh:
存储有需要批量删除键值对的下载链接，比如有读权限的OSS下载链接。

- 使用本接口的SDK进行调用时，SDK会自动将提交内容上传到OSS并传入对应的URL。

- 直接调用本接口需要将 JSON payload（格式同 BatchDeleteKv body：{"Namespace":"...","Keys":[...]})上传至 OSS bucket 并生成带签名的 HTTPS GET URL。
